newsitem.title: UK: Salomon Brothers poaches Warburg drug analysts.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers poaches Warburg drug analysts.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday it has signed Kevin Wilson and Jeremy Green to join its pharmaceuticals research team.
In a statement, Salomons said Wilson and Green will form a team with Alexandra Hauber and Andrew Baum to cover the U.K. and European drugs industry.
A spokeswoman said the U.S. investment bank has quadrupled the size of its pharmaceuticals research group in the past two months.
"It is an area we want to expand here because of its particular importance," she added.
Peter Laing, who acted as Salomon's sole European pharmaceuticals analyst before the recent expansion, left the bank in late June.
Wilson was head of Warburg's pharmaceutical equity research team. Green, who joined SBC Warburg in 1994, was a member of his team. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
